column2: [intro]
In this land of mountains and chocolate delights,
I’m an artist, oh wow, it's quite a sight!
On stage I dance, I sing, I put on a show,
But never too serious, for life here is aglow.
I’m the Swiss jester, making it bright,
With my smile, I dazzle the night,
Between the Alps and the lakes, I shine just right,
The Swiss jester, always full of delight.
With my guitar and my rhymes, I spin tales so grand,
The Swiss folks follow, for I’ve got a heart so grand,
On stage, I express, sharing love’s pure light,
From the heart of the mountains, joy takes flight.
I’m the Swiss jester, making it bright,
With my smile, I dazzle the night,
Between the Alps and the lakes, I shine just right,
The Swiss jester, always full of delight.
[ solo ]
And when the snow falls, everything turns magical,
I feel so free, everything's fantastical,
I know that laughter’s our sweetest music,
And in Switzerland, fun’s always fantastic.
[outro]
